description.value: Oh! Zzhu Sam Korean Restaurant has been part of the Burnaby community since 2016, offering creative Korean cuisine including stir-fry, octopus with pork belly, and signature Korean fried chicken. The restaurant emphasizes the harmony of food, atmosphere, and service as central to showcasing Korean food and culture. Dine-in service is available, as is delivery.

The website mentions 'Order for Delivery' and a 'Dine-in Menu', and OSM confirms indoor_seating=yes and outdoor_seating=no.
